name: Sigiriya Rock Fortress
description: Iconic fifth-century rock citadel, landscaped water gardens, frescoes and sweeping jungle panoramas.
notes: Early morning; allow 2–3 hours.

name: Pidurangala Rock
description: Rocky summit with a remarkable view of Sigiriya rising above the forest.
notes: Sunrise or sunset; steep rocky final section.

name: Dambulla Cave Temple
description: Historic cave sanctuary decorated with Buddhist murals and statues.
notes: Morning; dress modestly and remove shoes.

name: Polonnaruwa Medieval Kingdom
description: Medieval royal capital with monumental ruins, carved Buddha figures and ancient reservoirs.
notes: Start early; allow half to full day.

name: Anuradhapura Ancient Sacred City
description: Ancient royal city famed for enormous stupas, monasteries and the sacred Sri Maha Bodhi.
notes: Full day; carry water and wear temple-appropriate clothing.

name: Mihintale Sacred Cradle of Buddhism
description: Sacred hill complex associated with the introduction of Buddhism to Sri Lanka.
notes: Early morning or late afternoon.

name: Aukana Buddha Statue
description: Impressive ancient standing Buddha carved from a granite rock face.
notes: Combine with Anuradhapura or Dambulla.

name: Kandy & Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
description: Lakeside hill capital known for Buddhist heritage, markets and cultural performances.
activities: Visit the Temple of the Tooth
notes: 1–2 days; observe temple etiquette.

name: Peradeniya Royal Botanical Gardens
description: Expansive botanical gardens with orchids, palms and remarkable tropical trees.
notes: Half day; mornings are pleasant.

name: Ella & Nine Arch Bridge
description: Mountain town with tea landscapes, a striking railway viaduct and scenic trails.
notes: 2 days; check train schedules locally.

name: Ella Rock
description: Longer hill hike offering dramatic views across valleys and mountain ridges.
notes: Early start; trails can be confusing.

name: Ravana Falls
description: Picturesque roadside waterfall cascading through lush rock formations.
notes: Avoid slippery rocks and strong currents.

name: Nuwara Eliya
description: Cool-climate hill town surrounded by tea plantations and colonial-era architecture.
notes: 1–2 days; pack a jacket.

name: Horton Plains & World’s End
description: High-altitude grassland and cloud forest with a famous escarpment viewpoint.
notes: Begin at dawn before cloud builds.

name: Adam’s Peak / Sri Pada
description: Sacred pilgrimage mountain with a challenging staircase climb and sunrise views.
notes: Main pilgrimage season typically Dec–May; check conditions.

name: Knuckles Mountain Range
description: Rugged mountain wilderness with forests, remote villages and varied hiking routes.
notes: Hire a knowledgeable local guide.

name: Diyaluma Falls
description: Tall waterfall and scenic escarpment with upper cascade viewpoints.
notes: Water levels and rock safety vary.

name: Bambarakanda Falls
description: Sri Lanka’s tallest waterfall, surrounded by pine forest and mountain scenery.
notes: Best after adequate rainfall; avoid dangerous pools.

name: Haputale & Lipton’s Seat
description: Tea-country ridge offering wide views and plantation landscapes.
notes: Morning is best for clear views.

name: Galle Dutch Fort
description: Historic fortified coastal town with bastions, heritage streets and ocean-facing ramparts.
notes: Half to full day.

name: Unawatuna Beach & Jungle Bay
description: Popular sheltered beach area with coastal cafés and nearby coves.
notes: Check sea conditions and lifeguard guidance.

name: Mirissa (Coconut Tree Hill & Whale Bay)
description: Palm-fringed beach town known for ocean views and seasonal whale-watching trips.
notes: Marine trips depend on weather and season.

name: Weligama & Stilt Fishermen
description: Long sandy bay widely used for beginner surf lessons.
notes: Choose certified surf instructors.

name: Hikkaduwa
description: Lively beach destination with reef areas, surf breaks and restaurants.
notes: Do not touch coral or feed turtles.

name: Bentota Beach & Madu River Watersports
description: Resort beach and river estuary with water-based excursions.
notes: Water activities depend on sea and river conditions.

name: Tangalle & Rekawa
description: Quieter beaches and coastal landscapes, with important sea turtle nesting areas nearby.
notes: Avoid flash photography around nesting turtles.

name: Negombo Coastal Lagoon & Dutch Canal
description: Fishing town close to the international airport with canals and a lively market.
notes: Convenient first or final overnight stop.

name: Trincomalee & Nilaveli
description: Historic harbour region with white-sand beaches and nearby marine excursions.
notes: Often most suitable during the east-coast dry season.

name: Pigeon Island National Park
description: Protected marine environment noted for reefs and reef-associated wildlife.
notes: Use reef-safe practices; trips weather-dependent.

name: Pasikudah
description: East-coast bay known for its relatively shallow shoreline and resort atmosphere.
notes: Always assess currents and local safety notices.

name: Arugam Bay
description: Internationally known surf destination with a relaxed beach-town atmosphere.
notes: Surf season generally strongest around May–September.

name: Jaffna & Nallur Kandaswamy Temple
description: Distinctive northern cultural centre with Tamil heritage, temples and regional cuisine.
notes: Dress respectfully at religious sites.

name: Delft Island
description: Remote island with coral-stone walls, coastal scenery and free-roaming horses.
notes: Ferry services and conditions can change.

name: Mannar & Talaimannar
description: Quiet coastal region with historic landmarks, bird habitats and distinctive landscapes.
notes: Plan transport and check seasonal bird activity.

name: Yala National Park (Leopard Sanctuary)
description: Dry-zone wilderness renowned for leopards, elephants, crocodiles and birds.
notes: Dawn or afternoon; sightings are never guaranteed.

name: Udawalawe National Park (Elephant Transit)
description: Open grasslands and reservoirs that provide excellent opportunities to observe elephants.
notes: Morning or late afternoon.

name: Minneriya National Park (The Elephant Gathering)
description: Reservoir-side park famous for seasonal elephant gatherings.
notes: Seasonal wildlife movements vary by rainfall.

name: Wilpattu National Park
description: Large forest-and-lake national park known for natural villu lakes and diverse wildlife.
notes: Allow half or full day.

name: Sinharaja Biosphere Rainforest
description: UNESCO-listed tropical rainforest rich in endemic birds, plants and biodiversity.
notes: Bring rain protection and leech socks.

name: Bundala National Park
description: Wetland habitats important for migratory waterbirds and other wildlife.
notes: Best with an experienced naturalist.

name: Kitulgala
description: Rainforest river destination popular for outdoor adventure and river activities.
notes: Use qualified operators; conditions vary after rain.

name: Colombo
description: Sri Lanka’s commercial capital blends colonial landmarks, temples, museums and modern dining.
notes: 1–2 days; allow for city traffic.

name: Ambalangoda
description: Coastal town known for traditional mask carving and performing-arts heritage.
notes: Easy stop between Colombo and Galle.

name: Kalpitiya
description: Peninsula with lagoons, sandbars and seasonal marine experiences.
notes: Wind and marine seasons differ; check locally.

name: Hiriketiya Horseshoe Bay
description: Picturesque horseshoe-shaped turquoise bay fringed by coconut palms, renowned for mellow surf breaks, relaxed beachside cafés and calm ocean swimming.
notes: Sheltered cove with year-round calm swimming; prime surf season November to April.
